headline: 0 EVM addresses catalogued; protocol runs exclusively on Provenance Blockchain (Cosmos SDK / bech32), which is outside DeFiPunkd's supported chain set and has no EVM contract addresses

findings.text: D1: Provenance Blockchain is not an EVM chain and uses bech32 addresses (pb1...), not 0x hex. No canonical EVM block explorer (etherscan, basescan, arbiscan, etc.) covers Provenance. No name-tag search possible on supported explorers. Recorded in unknowns.

D2: Protocol website (figure.com/crypto-backed-loan) and figuremarkets.com fetched. No deployed-contracts page was found. The Smart Contract Addendum at figuremarkets.com/disclosures/Democratized_Prime_Smart_Contract_Pool_Addendum/ references Provenance-native asset identifiers (ylds.fcc, forge.cbl, forge.heloc, forge.nq.heloc) but no hex contract addresses. No deployed_contracts_doc URL discovered.
D3: protocol.audit_links is empty (none recorded). No audit PDFs surfaced from website or search. Recorded in unknowns.
D4: protocol.github is empty (none recorded). No GitHub repository was discovered via search results for Figure Markets Democratized Prime. Recorded in unknowns.
D5: Only one chain listed (Provenance). No multi-chain EVM deployments found. Hastra/PRIME token has a Solana presence per press releases but no Solana addresses were surfaced in fetched documents.
D6: No factory addresses discoverable without on-chain access to Provenance. DeFiPunkd read API does not support Provenance (chainId not in supported set). Recorded in unknowns.

D7: Provenance asset identifiers found in Smart Contract Addendum: ylds.fcc (supply/borrow asset), forge.cbl (collateral for crypto-backed loan pool), forge.heloc and forge.nq.heloc (collateral for home equity loan pool). These are Provenance marker denoms, not EVM addresses. Cannot populate admin_addresses with 0x addresses.
D8: No hex addresses found in any fetched page. No admin_addresses entries can be created. All Provenance-native identifiers are recorded as unknowns rather than address entries.

rationale.verdict: Discovery is blocked by chain incompatibility: Figure Markets Democratized Prime runs entirely on Provenance Blockchain, a Cosmos SDK chain using bech32 addresses (pb1...) that is not in DeFiPunkd's supported chainId set. The official Smart Contract Addendum confirms smart contracts are deployed on Provenance and references protocol asset identifiers (ylds.fcc, forge.cbl, forge.heloc), but no EVM-format (0x) contract addresses appear in any fetched source. No GitHub repo and no audit PDF were discoverable. Website and press-release corpora were fully walked; 0 EVM addresses catalogued.

evidence.shows: Protocol website probe: page loads (HTTP 200); describes Figure crypto-backed loans; links to figuremarkets.com for Democratized Prime login. No contract addresses listed.

Figure Markets homepage: confirms Democratized Prime is a lending marketplace built on Provenance Blockchain using YLDS as supply/borrow asset and HELOC collateral; no contract addresses listed; references figuremarkets.com/c/democratized-prime/

Official Smart Contract Addendum (last updated May 20, 2026): defines Democratized Prime as smart-contract-based lending pools on 'a digital asset network'; lists two live pools: (1) Crypto-Backed Loan pool (supply/borrow: ylds.fcc, collateral: forge.cbl, LTV 95%, liquidation 100%, penalty 2%, reserve factor 0.05883%); (2) Home Equity Loan pool (supply/borrow: ylds.fcc, collateral: forge.heloc / forge.nq.heloc at 100%/94.73% advance rates, same LTV/liquidation/penalty/reserve). Oracle/Valuation source: Forge. No hex contract addresses disclosed.

Dec 4 2025 press release: PRIME token is powered by Democratized Prime decentralized lending protocol on Provenance Blockchain; Hastra liquidity protocol incubated by Figure and Provenance Blockchain Foundation distributes yields; PRIME accessible at hastra.io; Kamino Finance on Solana is borrow-lend partner. Confirms Provenance is the home chain for Democratized Prime.

Wikipedia: In August 2025, Figure merged with Figure Markets; launched Democratized Prime allowing institutional and retail users to lend and borrow using tokenized collateral on Provenance Blockchain; YLDS is SEC-registered yield-bearing stablecoin native to Provenance.
July 2025 merger announcement: Democratized Prime described as decentralized prime brokerage and warehouse line alternative connecting capital to tokenized collateral on Provenance Blockchain.

protocol_metadata.about: Figure Markets Democratized Prime is a decentralized lending marketplace operating on the Provenance Blockchain where users can supply YLDS (an SEC-registered yield-bearing stablecoin) to smart-contract-based lending pools and earn yield, or borrow YLDS by pledging tokenized real-world assets (primarily Figure-originated HELOCs and crypto-backed loans) as collateral. Pools use live variable rates determined by utilization, with a 95% collateral ratio, 100% liquidation threshold, and 2% liquidation penalty. The protocol uses 'Forge' as its oracle and valuation source for collateral assets, and is connected to the broader Hastra/PRIME liquidity ecosystem that bridges Provenance yields to Solana DeFi via Chainlink CCIP.
